events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (/app/index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

input.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #060405; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; touch-action: none; cursor: crosshair; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen glowing in the dark"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
'use strict';
const cv = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
const TAU = Math.PI * 2, K = 0.45;
const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let reduced = mq.matches;

/* ---------- seeded random ---------- */
let seed = 20261110;
const rnd = () => { seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, 1 | seed); t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t; return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const rr = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * rnd();

/* ---------- state ---------- */
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1, R = 100, CX = 0, CY = 0, BR = 86, BY = 0;
let T = 0, last = 0, raf = 0;
const ptr = { x: 0, y: 0, px: 0, py: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, on: 0, onT: 0, has: false };
let lx = -0.35, ly = -0.3;            // smoothed light position (-1..1)
let ripples = [], lastRip = 0, nextBubble = 1;

/* ---------- static scene data ---------- */
const strands = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 38; i++) strands.push({
  ox: rr(-0.24, 0.24), oy: rr(-0.2, 0.2), A: rr(0.22, 0.56), B: rr(0.16, 0.5),
  th: rr(0, TAU), span: rr(2.2, 4.6), rot: rr(0, Math.PI), wf: rr(3, 6), wa: rr(0.02, 0.05), ph: rr(0, TAU)
});
const droplets = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) droplets.push({ a: rr(0, TAU), r: 0.3 + Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.62, s: rr(0.012, 0.045), ox: 0, oy: 0, w: rr(0.6, 1.4) });
const scallions = [], chilis = [], sesame = [], corn = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 17; i++) { const a = rr(0, TAU), r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.36; scallions.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r + 0.02, y: Math.sin(a) * r + 0.02, s: rr(0.026, 0.04), rot: rr(0, Math.PI), k: rr(0.45, 0.9), ph: rr(0, TAU), g: rnd() }); }
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const a = rr(0, TAU), r = rr(0.08, 0.4); chilis.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, s: rr(0.02, 0.028), rot: rr(0, Math.PI), k: rr(0.5, 0.85), ph: rr(0, TAU) }); }
for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) { const a = rr(0, TAU), r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.6; sesame.push({ x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, rot: rr(0, Math.PI), d: rnd() < 0.25 }); }
for (let i = 0; i < 13; i++) { const a = rr(0, TAU), r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.115; corn.push({ x: 0.03 + Math.cos(a) * r * 1.25, y: 0.58 + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.8, rot: rr(-0.6, 0.6), s: rr(0.9, 1.15), ph: rr(0, TAU) }); }
corn.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
const bokeh = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) bokeh.push({ x: rnd(), y: rr(0.02, 0.62), r: rr(0.05, 0.2), a: rr(0.025, 0.075), ph: rr(0, TAU), sp: rr(0.1, 0.3), hue: rr(18, 40), d: rr(0.4, 1) });
const motes = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) motes.push({ x: rnd(), y: rnd(), s: rr(0.6, 1.8), sp: rr(0.004, 0.014), ph: rr(0, TAU), a: rr(0.15, 0.5) });
const noriSpecks = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) noriSpecks.push({ u: rnd(), v: rnd(), l: rr(0.02, 0.06), a: rr(-0.5, 0.5) });
const bowlSpecks = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) bowlSpecks.push({ x: rr(-0.95, 0.95), y: rr(0.05, 0.8), s: rr(0.003, 0.008), a: rr(0.05, 0.2) });

/* ---------- steam ---------- */
const sprite = document.createElement('canvas');
sprite.width = sprite.height = 128;
{
  const s = sprite.getContext('2d');
  const g = s.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,244,230,1)');
  g.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255,240,224,0.55)');
  g.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(255,236,218,0.14)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,236,218,0)');
  s.fillStyle = g; s.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
}
const steam = [];
function spawnSteam(p, burst) {
  const a = Math.random() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * (burst ? 0.25 : 0.62);
  p.x = (burst ? burst.x : 0) * 0.86 + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.86;
  p.y = 0.07 + ((burst ? burst.y : 0) + Math.sin(a) * r) * 0.86 * K - 0.04;
  p.vy0 = -(0.1 + Math.random() * 0.13) * (burst ? 1.6 : 1);
  p.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05; p.vy = p.vy0 * 0.6;
  p.life = 4.5 + Math.random() * 4.5; p.age = 0;
  p.size = 0.16 + Math.random() * 0.2; p.rot = Math.random() * TAU; p.vr = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3;
  p.asp = 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.5; p.seed = Math.random() * 100; p.al = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6;
  return p;
}
for (let i = 0; i < 84; i++) { const p = spawnSteam({}); p.age = Math.random() * p.life; p.y += p.vy0 * p.age * 0.8; steam.push(p); }

function stepSteam(dt) {
  const mx = (ptr.x - CX) / R, my = (ptr.y - CY) / R;
  for (const p of steam) {
    p.age += dt;
    if (p.age > p.life) { spawnSteam(p); continue; }
    const fx = Math.sin(p.y * 4 + T * 0.6 + p.seed) * 0.06 + Math.sin(p.y * 9.5 - T * 1.1 + p.seed * 2) * 0.025;
    p.vx += (fx - p.vx * 0.9 - p.x * 0.06) * dt;
    p.vy += (p.vy0 - p.vy) * 0.7 * dt;
    if (ptr.on > 0.01) {
      const dx = p.x - mx, dy = p.y - my, d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy, f = Math.exp(-d2 / 0.09) * ptr.on;
      const d = Math.sqrt(d2) + 0.001;
      p.vx += (ptr.vx * 2.2 + dx / d * 0.35) * f * dt;
      p.vy += (ptr.vy * 2.2 + dy / d * 0.2) * f * dt;
    }
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.rot += p.vr * dt;
  }
}
function drawSteam() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  for (const p of steam) {
    const q = p.age / p.life;
    const al = Math.min(1, p.age / 0.9) * Math.pow(1 - q, 1.4) * 0.105 * p.al;
    if (al < 0.003) continue;
    const s = p.size * (1 + 2.1 * q) * R;
    ctx.globalAlpha = al;
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, (CX + p.x * R) * DPR, (CY + p.y * R) * DPR);
    ctx.rotate(Math.sin(p.rot) * 0.5);
    ctx.drawImage(sprite, -s * p.asp / 2, -s * 0.75, s * p.asp, s * 1.5);
  }
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const PX = x => CX + x * BR;
const PY = (y, z) => BY + y * BR * K - (z || 0) * R;
function el(x, y, rx, ry, rot) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, Math.max(0.01, rx), Math.max(0.01, ry), rot || 0, 0, TAU); }
function rippleH(x, y) {
  let h = 0;
  for (const r of ripples) {
    const age = T - r.t, e = Math.hypot(x - r.x, y - r.y) - age * 0.55;
    h += r.a * Math.exp(-e * e * 55) * Math.cos(e * 26) * Math.max(0, 1 - age / r.life);
  }
  return h;
}
const bob = (x, y, ph) => 0.004 * Math.sin(T * 1.3 + ph) + rippleH(x, y) * 0.55;
const mound = (x, y) => 0.075 * Math.max(0, 1 - (x * x + y * y) * 1.6);
function addRipple(x, y, a, life) { if (ripples.length > 14) ripples.shift(); ripples.push({ x, y, a, t: T, life: life || 2.2 }); }

/* ---------- background ---------- */
function drawBackground(fl) {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#060405'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const big = Math.max(W, H);
  let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX + lx * R * 0.5, CY - R * 0.25 + ly * R * 0.2, 0, CX, CY, big * 0.75);
  g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(96,46,18,${0.5 * fl})`);
  g.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(48,22,12,${0.38 * fl})`);
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6,4,5,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // bokeh
  ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  for (const b of bokeh) {
    const x = b.x * W + Math.sin(T * b.sp + b.ph) * R * 0.12 - lx * R * 0.1 * b.d;
    const y = b.y * H + Math.cos(T * b.sp * 0.7 + b.ph) * R * 0.06 - ly * R * 0.05 * b.d;
    const r = b.r * R * 1.3, a = b.a * (0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(T * 0.5 + b.ph * 3));
    g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
    g.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${b.hue},85%,58%,${a})`);
    g.addColorStop(0.7, `hsla(${b.hue},85%,50%,${a * 0.7})`);
    g.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${b.hue},85%,50%,0)`);
    ctx.fillStyle = g; el(x, y, r, r); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // table
  const ty = CY + R * 0.2;
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ty, 0, Math.max(H, ty + R * 1.6));
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(34,18,10,0)');
  g.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(40,21,11,0.92)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,6,5,1)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, ty, W, H - ty);
  // subtle wood grain
  ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.07; ctx.strokeStyle = '#e8a060'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const y = CY + R * (0.62 + i * i * 0.022 + i * 0.05);
    if (y > H) break;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y + Math.sin(i * 2.1) * 4);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(W * 0.3, y + Math.sin(i * 1.3) * 7, W * 0.7, y - Math.cos(i * 1.7) * 7, W, y + Math.sin(i) * 4);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  // warm pool under bowl
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(CX, CY + R * 0.84); ctx.scale(1, 0.26);
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx * R * 0.2, 0, R * 0.2, 0, 0, R * 2.3);
  g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(190,96,36,${0.36 * fl})`);
  g.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(120,54,20,${0.16 * fl})`);
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(80,30,10,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; el(0, 0, R * 2.3, R * 2.3); ctx.fill();
  // contact shadow (leans away from the light)
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(-lx * R * 0.18, 0, R * 0.15, -lx * R * 0.18, 0, R * 1.05);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.92)'); g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; el(-lx * R * 0.18, 0, R * 1.05, R * 1.05); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ---------- bowl ---------- */
function bodyPath() {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(CX - R, CY);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(CX - R * 0.99, CY + R * 0.42, CX - R * 0.74, CY + R * 0.72, CX - R * 0.44, CY + R * 0.77);
  ctx.lineTo(CX - R * 0.42, CY + R * 0.84);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(CX, CY + R * 0.93, CX + R * 0.42, CY + R * 0.84);
  ctx.lineTo(CX + R * 0.44, CY + R * 0.77);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(CX + R * 0.74, CY + R * 0.72, CX + R * 0.99, CY + R * 0.42, CX + R, CY);
  ctx.closePath();
}
function drawBowlBody(fl) {
  const hp = 0.5 + lx * 0.3;
  bodyPath();
  let g = ctx.createLinearGradient(CX - R, 0, CX + R, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#05070a');
  g.addColorStop(Math.max(0.05, hp - 0.3), '#0f1820');
  g.addColorStop(hp, '#27394a');
  g.addColorStop(Math.min(0.95, hp + 0.3), '#0f1820');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#05070a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
  ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
  // vertical falloff
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, CY, 0, CY + R * 0.9);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'); g.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(CX - R, CY - R * 0.5, R * 2, R * 1.5);
  // glaze bands
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(214,150,84,0.26)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, R * 0.012);
  el(CX, CY + R * 0.17, R * 0.985, R * K * 0.985); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(214,150,84,0.14)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, R * 0.006);
  el(CX, CY + R * 0.215, R * 0.955, R * K * 0.955); ctx.stroke();
  // speckle
  for (const s of bowlSpecks) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(190,215,235,${s.a})`; el(CX + s.x * R, CY + s.y * R, s.s * R, s.s * R); ctx.fill(); }
  // specular streak
  const sx = CX + (hp - 0.5) * 2 * R * 0.8;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(sx, CY + R * 0.42); ctx.rotate((hp - 0.5) * -0.9); ctx.scale(0.3, 1);
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, R * 0.42);
  g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,220,180,${0.34 * fl})`); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,150,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; el(0, 0, R * 0.42, R * 0.42); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
  // warm bounce from the table
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, CY + R * 0.5, 0, CY + R * 0.9);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(200,90,30,0)'); g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(200,90,30,${0.2 * fl})`);
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(CX - R, CY + R * 0.5, R * 2, R * 0.5);
  ctx.restore();

  // rim (outer lip)
  el(CX, CY, R, R * K);
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(CX - R, CY - R * K, CX + R, CY + R * K);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#1a2632'); g.addColorStop(Math.min(0.9, Math.max(0.1, hp)), '#6d8499'); g.addColorStop(1, '#141c25');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
  // inner wall
  el(CX, CY + R * 0.012, R * 0.93, R * 0.93 * K);
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, CY - R * 0.42, 0, CY - R * 0.2);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#111a23'); g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${110 * fl | 0},54,22,1)`);
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
}

/* ---------- broth & noodles (clipped to the opening) ---------- */
function drawBroth(fl) {
  ctx.save();
  el(CX, CY + R * 0.012, R * 0.93, R * 0.93 * K); ctx.clip();
  // surface
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(CX, BY); ctx.scale(BR, BR * K);
  let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx * 0.3, -0.15 + ly * 0.2, 0.05, 0, 0, 1);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#f0ac55'); g.addColorStop(0.45, '#cf7a2a'); g.addColorStop(0.85, '#96481a'); g.addColorStop(1, '#5e2a0e');
  ctx.fillStyle = g; el(0, 0, 1, 1); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // slow drifting sheen
  ctx.save(); ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const a = T * 0.12 + i * 1.7, x = Math.cos(a) * 0.5 + lx * 0.2, y = Math.sin(a * 1.3) * 0.5;
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(PX(x), PY(y)); ctx.rotate(Math.sin(a) * 0.4); ctx.scale(1, 0.22);
    g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, R * 0.42);
    g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,214,150,${0.13 * fl})`); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,120,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g; el(0, 0, R * 0.42, R * 0.42); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // chili-oil droplets
  const mdx = (ptr.x - CX) / BR, mdy = (ptr.y - BY) / (BR * K);
  for (const d of droplets) {
    const a = d.a + T * 0.035 * d.w;
    let x = Math.cos(a) * d.r + d.ox, y = Math.sin(a) * d.r + d.oy;
    if (ptr.on > 0.05) {
      const dx = x - mdx, dy = y - mdy, dd = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      if (dd < 0.07) { const f = (0.07 - dd) * 0.9 * ptr.on; d.ox += dx * f; d.oy += dy * f; }
    }
    d.ox *= 0.985; d.oy *= 0.985;
    const h = rippleH(x, y);
    const sx = PX(x), sy = PY(y, h * 0.5), s = d.s * R * (1 + h * 6);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(214,62,18,0.5)'; el(sx, sy, s, s * K * 1.1); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,150,50,0.5)'; el(sx, sy - s * 0.06, s * 0.72, s * K * 0.75); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,232,180,0.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(0.6, R * 0.004);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(sx, sy, s * 0.72, s * K * 0.72, 0, Math.PI * (1.05 - lx * 0.2), Math.PI * (1.5 - lx * 0.2)); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ripples
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  for (const r of ripples) {
    const age = T - r.t, q = age / r.life; if (q >= 1) continue;
    const rad = age * 0.55 + 0.01, al = (1 - q) * (1 - q) * Math.min(1, r.a * 28);
    for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
      const rd = rad - k * 0.07; if (rd <= 0) continue;
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(CX, BY); ctx.scale(BR, BR * K);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, rd, 0, TAU); ctx.restore();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,226,170,${al * (k ? 0.22 : 0.42)})`; ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.012; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(CX, BY + R * 0.012); ctx.scale(BR, BR * K);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r.x, r.y, rd, 0, TAU); ctx.restore();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(70,24,6,${al * (k ? 0.16 : 0.3)})`; ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.01; ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // noodles
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  const N = 26, pts = new Float32Array((N + 1) * 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < strands.length; i++) {
    const s = strands[i], cr = Math.cos(s.rot), sr = Math.sin(s.rot);
    for (let j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
      const a = s.th + (j / N) * s.span;
      const ux = s.A * Math.cos(a) + s.wa * Math.sin(s.wf * a + s.ph + T * 0.55);
      const uy = s.B * Math.sin(a) + s.wa * Math.cos(s.wf * 0.9 * a + s.ph + T * 0.45);
      let x = s.ox + ux * cr - uy * sr, y = s.oy + ux * sr + uy * cr;
      const d = Math.hypot(x, y); if (d > 0.8) { x *= 0.8 / d; y *= 0.8 / d; }
      pts[j * 2] = PX(x); pts[j * 2 + 1] = PY(y, mound(x, y) + rippleH(x, y) * 0.6);
    }
    const path = (oy) => {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pts[0], pts[1] + oy);
      for (let j = 1; j < N; j++) ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pts[j * 2], pts[j * 2 + 1] + oy, (pts[j * 2] + pts[j * 2 + 2]) / 2, (pts[j * 2 + 1] + pts[j * 2 + 3]) / 2 + oy);
      ctx.lineTo(pts[N * 2], pts[N * 2 + 1] + oy);
    };
    const depth = i / strands.length, lw = R * 0.03;
    path(lw * 0.3); ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(110,56,14,${0.5 + depth * 0.25})`; ctx.lineWidth = lw * 1.3; ctx.stroke();
    const L = 52 + depth * 22;
    path(0); ctx.strokeStyle = `hsl(42,${72 - depth * 6}%,${L}%)`; ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.stroke();
    path(-lw * 0.22); ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(48,95%,${L + 14}%,${0.35 + depth * 0.4})`; ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.3; ctx.stroke();
  }

  const tx = ptr.has ? (ptr.x / W) * 2 - 1 : Math.sin(T * 0.2) * 0.45 - 0.1;
  const ty = ptr.has ? (ptr.y / H) * 2 - 1 : -0.3 + Math.cos(T * 0.17) * 0.15;

/* ---------- interaction ---------- */

function onMove(e) {

  }
  const now = performance.now();
  if (ptr.has) {
    const dt = Math.max(8, now - ptr.pt) / 1000;
    const vx = (x - ptr.x) / R / dt, vy = (y - ptr.y) / R / dt;
    ptr.vx += (Math.max(-3, Math.min(3, vx)) - ptr.vx) * 0.35;
    ptr.vy += (Math.max(-3, Math.min(3, vy)) - ptr.vy) * 0.35;
  }
  ptr.x = x; ptr.y = y; ptr.pt = now; ptr.has = true;
  const [bx, by] = brothPos(x, y);

}

The page is at `/app/index.html`: a single file with inline CSS and JS, drawn entirely on a 2D canvas, with no external assets or raster images.

I could not look at it in a browser here (none is installed), so the visual result is unchecked. I ran the script against a stubbed canvas in normal, reduced-motion and narrow-viewport modes with simulated pointer input; that turned up one out-of-range gradient error, now fixed, and it runs clean.

- **Scene:** a dark glazed bowl on a dim table, holding orange miso-style broth with chili-oil droplets and a nest of noodles. Toppings are seared tofu cubes, shiitake caps, bok choy, lotus root slices, corn, scallions, chili rings, sesame and a standing sheet of nori.
- **Ambient motion:** steam rises and curls, the broth simmers with occasional ripples, noodles and toppings bob, the warm light flickers, and dust motes and soft background lights drift.
- **Mouse and touch:**
  - The light follows the pointer, shifting the highlights on the bowl and broth, with a slight parallax.
  - Moving over the broth makes ripples and pushes the oil droplets aside.
  - Moving through the steam pushes it around.
  - A click or tap makes a larger ripple and a puff of steam.
- **Responsive:** the bowl scales to the smaller viewport dimension and the canvas redraws on resize.
- **Reduced motion:** the page renders one still frame with a settled steam plume and no animation loop. The only response is the light following the pointer.
